verdict.rationale: Tailscale ships and documents an official CLI (tailscale-cli reference) and highlights automation via infrastructure-as-code and webhooks, supporting scriptable/agentic use, but there is no evidence of AI-native specific tooling (e.g., agent-oriented commands, LLM integration) beyond a generic networking CLI. missing for 10: AI-agent-specific CLI features, independent hands-on validation of CLI use in agentic workflows.
